capabilities: Read French-Chinese bilingual seminar texts by segment ID with in-text search
Edit Chinese translations, notes, and comments in place while reading
Sync seminar texts, attachments, and knowledge cards from a WordPress library with local-change protection
Look up French words, translate selections via CLI, and save to an Eudic wordbook
Run read-only AI interpretation of segments through Codex CLI, Claude Code, or DeepSeek Harness
disambiguation: Not a general translation tool; it works only with vaults in the Lacan Chinese translation project's format and its seminar corpus.
extras: Interface and generated materials are primarily in Chinese; seminar features require a vault matching the translation project's directory format; manifest is desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true); the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README states the repository was split out of the Lacan Chinese translation project as a standalone plugin to support reading, editing, and comparing its published translations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for reading segment-aligned bilingual translation projects or syncing a published seminar corpus with per-lesson notes and terminology.
